items.period: Shuowen seal-script tradition; historical model associated with the Han dictionary tradition, exact graphic date unspecified
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 館 in a Shuowen seal-script style. It illustrates the traditional 食+官 form cited by Shuowen; it is not an ancient artifact image.
items.alt: Black seal-script style 館 glyph redrawn as a vector on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: The Commons description explicitly identifies the glyph as 館 in Shuowen seal style and reports public-domain status; it provides a useful visual counterpart to the traditional dictionary component analysis.
items.rights: Public domain according to the Commons file description; redraw, not a scan or artifact photo.

limitations.text: One usable glyph image was verified. Xiaoxuetang access failed and Commons oracle/bronze/big-seal candidate pages returned errors, so this selection cannot illustrate the disputed earlier 宛/𩜌 graphic sequence.
